text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, going with this design was 
definitely the right choice~
choice_data_list: All that brainstorming really paid off.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It feels so nostalgic now. I've still kept 
the notebooks from back then, you know~
choice_data_list: たくさん案出ししたかいがあった
choice_data_list_en: All that brainstorming was definitely worth it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember~? There were so many ideas 
that were totally useless, weren't there?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
All right. Just because it's a racing 
outfit doesn't mean it has to be stiff and 
formal, so playful touches are an absolute 
must, I'd say!
choice_data_list: Looks like you're having fun.
Looks like you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Fufun, do you understand?
choice_data_list: 楽しそうだな
楽しそうだね
choice_data_list_en: Looks like fun.
Looks like fun, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You know, when I try to think through all 
kinds of stuff and turn my vision into 
reality, it turns out to be pretty tough.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I just suddenly remembered that 
crowdfunding thing.
choice_data_list: Crowdfunding?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. When you look at those kinds of 
sites, there are tons of people trying to 
bring all sorts of ideas to life, right?
choice_data_list: クラファン？
choice_data_list_en: Crowdfunding?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
There are wacky ideas that you'd never 
normally come up with, too. It makes you 
realize, 'Ah, these people are trying to 
give shape to what they love.'

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So I was thinking maybe I could try doing 
that in my racing outfit too, y'know?
choice_data_list: To give shape to my 'love'...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I agreed that it certainly sounded fun. As 
I nodded along, Transcend suddenly made an 
expression as if something had crossed her 
mind.
choice_data_list: 『好き』を形にか……
choice_data_list_en: Giving form to what you love, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is she troubled by some part of the 
design? I call out to her, hoping to cheer 
her up.
choice_data_list: I hope it turns out great.
I hope it turns out well.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. Yeah. I wanna make something good.
choice_data_list: いいものができるといいな
いいものができるといいね
choice_data_list_en: I hope we can make something great.
I hope you make something great.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, we arrived at the gadget 
expo. She thought it might give her ideas 
for a racing outfit, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you for some great ideas 
too, Trainer-chan~!
choice_data_list: Is it alright if I voice my opinion?
Can I share my thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Sure thing. Alright, ready... set...
choice_data_list: 意見を言っていいのか？
意見を言っていいの？
choice_data_list_en: Is it okay if I speak my mind?
Can I share my thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After checking out the gadget expo, I 
decided to brainstorm ideas with Transcend 
at a cafe, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Pffft... That was totally indulging their 
hobby, huh. Being able to record data 
through pen strokes seems practical 
enough, but still..."
choice_data_list: It's hard to grip!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's all craggy and rugged for a magic 
wand, y'know~. They went way too far with 
that design.
choice_data_list: 握りにくい！
choice_data_list_en: It's hard to grip!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, no way that's... Wait. The smoky 
scent from that delicacy earlier is 
lingering on my fingers...
choice_data_list: デザイン案に追加しよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's add that to the design concepts.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll add this fragrance to the 
ideas too.
choice_data_list: I-I hate this so much...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. ...Ah, but that electronic 
component we saw embedded in the fabric 
earlier—
choice_data_list: い、いやすぎる……！
choice_data_list_en: I-I hate this so much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The notebook quickly filled up. Joking 
around, laughing, and brainstorming 
seriously, we threw out ideas for as long 
as time allowed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And what was created was...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: You know, this racing attire...
choice_data_list:
Almost all the design proposals I 
submitted got rejected...

Almost all of the design proposals I 
submitted got rejected...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Pfft, what made you think that'd work?
choice_data_list: 俺が出したデザイン案はほぼボツに……
私が出したデザイン案はほぼボツに……
choice_data_list_en: Almost all the design proposals I submitted got scrapped...
Almost all of my design proposals got scrapped...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Totally~. Bless the gadget expo.
choice_data_list: でも機能面はいい感じだった
choice_data_list_en: Still, the functionality felt pretty good.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Hum-de-hum♪ I just can't stop smiling~. 
Hehehe.
choice_data_list: Because it turned out so well?
Did you just remember something funny?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well, that's part of it, too.
choice_data_list: できのよさに？
思い出し笑い？
choice_data_list_en: At how well it turned out?
Laughing at a memory?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I'm just so overwhelmed with 
emotion that I actually found something I 
want to do."
choice_data_list: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Just saying how much fun it was making it 
together.
choice_data_list: ん？
choice_data_list_en: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Feel free to thank me, you know?
choice_data_list: 手伝わせてくれて嬉しかった
choice_data_list_en: I was really happy you let me help.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Pfft, you're way too honest!
choice_data_list: ありがとうございます！！
choice_data_list_en: Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after, they continued to 
happily reminisce about the time they made 
her racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I'd say it's not wrong, personally.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I'd better get heading home soon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't get a definitive answer, but 
Transcend seemed to be having a lot of 
fun. Waving and telling her good work, I 
watched her leave.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Mm, good work, buddy.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, of course I'd chuckle just 
remembering that."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Trainer-chan will get a racing 
outfit too~. Then we could once again—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking down the twilight hallway with a 
light step, Transcend looked happy from 
behind.
